   method processCommand(in_out varchar inputTransaction, in_out varchar outputTransaction) returns int;

         detection.describe_cmd(outputTransaction);
      end;

         detection.validate(inputTransaction, outputTransaction);
      end;
      else
         return 1;
   return 0;

   method processTransaction( in_out varchar inputTransaction, in_out varchar outputTransaction) returns int;
      declare int rc;
      declare varchar(8) temp;

      rc = deserialize( inputTransaction, outputTransaction );
      if (rc ^= 0) then return rc;

      if (message.request.command ^= 'Execute') then
         processCommand(inputTransaction, outputTransaction);
      else do;
         getSignatures();
         executeModels();
         executeRules();
         putSignatures();
         serialize(outputTransaction);
      end;
      return 0;
   end; /* method processTransaction */

package GlobalContext / overwrite = yes;

    dcl varchar(1024) ctxtKey;
    dcl package Container ctxtValue;
    dcl package hash context();

    method init();
        context.definekey('ctxtKey');
        context.definedata('ctxtValue');
        context.defineDone();
    end;

    method add(varchar(1024) key, package Container value);
        ctxtKey = key;
        ctxtValue = value;
        context.ref();
    end;

    method getItemCount(in_out integer count);
        count = context.num_items;
    end;

    method find(varchar(1024) key, in_out package Container value);
        ctxtKey = key;
        context.find();
        value = ctxtValue;
    end;

endpackage;
